name: Shit Stealing Gnomes
summary: Shit Stealing Gnomes is a first-person co-op stealth adventure in which players take on the role of rebellious gnomes infiltrating human houses to steal specific items from a mandatory To-Steal list, as well as extra loot for personal wealth. Progressing through the ranks of the Gnomic Resistance unlocks equipment such as assault ladders, drones, night vision, and item detectors, alongside upgrades for the team's car, which acts as a mobile safehouse and hub during missions.
